title: Bring Your Own AI — implementation
summary: Allow users to bring their own AI credentials, configured per user, with encrypted storage and quota awareness - while guaranteeing the platform remains fully usable with no paid API via local Ollama. Tracks all implementation stories for this epic.
acceptance_criteria: A user can add, rotate and remove provider keys; keys encrypted at rest
Keys are never displayed after entry and never appear in logs
The platform works end-to-end with no keys via local Ollama
Per-user usage/quota is visible to that user
notes:
Scope (in): Encrypted API key storage; Per-user provider selection and configuration; Quota awareness; Key management (add, rotate, remove)
Out of scope: The provider abstraction itself (EPIC-008); Generating critiques (EPIC-010); Billing/payments
